modal.title: Settings
modal.no-matches: No settings match your search in this category.
modal.context-warning: Selected model maxes at {{max}} tokens. Lower the limit or switch to a larger-context model.
modal.about-tagline: Local-first workspace for confidential client work.

shortcuts.quick-tip-open-file: to quickly open any file by name. Press
shortcuts.quick-tip-overlay: to show the keyboard shortcuts overlay anywhere in the app.

link.title: Booking link
link.placeholder-note: This is a local placeholder. The public booking page is wired in the next phase.

license.title: License
license.description: A license keeps AI chat, workflows, and all {{productName}} features running after your trial. Keys are available at <pricingLink>lantern.com</pricingLink>.
license.deactivate-confirm: Deactivate this license? You will lose access to paid features until you re-activate.
license.ownership-tagline: Your files are always yours. If you ever cancel, you keep every document, email, and client you have made. A lapsed subscription turns off the AI features and updates, not your data.
license.trial-expired-detail: Your {{days}}-day free trial ended on <endDateBold>{{endDate}}</endDateBold>. AI chat and workflows are paused. Your existing files are still here, fully readable. Activate a license to keep building.
license.trial-active-detail: You're on the free trial. Every {{productName}} feature is unlocked for {{days}} days from first launch, bring your own AI keys, run workflows, edit files, the works. When the trial ends, AI chat and workflows pause until you activate a license; your files stay accessible.
license.recovery-detail: Enter your license code to restore it on this computer. No account needed.

unlocks.ai-chat: AI chat with your own keys (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini)
unlocks.workspaces: Open as many folders as you need, files, and version history
unlocks.updates: Continuous updates, legal-content maintenance, and security patches
unlocks.all-packs: Shared clients, admin console, and assured zero-retention routing (Firm)

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: {{productName}} keeps your work on this computer. Optional sharing is off unless you turn it on.

optional-sharing.title: Optional sharing
optional-sharing.description: {{productName}} keeps your work on this computer. Optional sharing is off unless you turn it on.

design-partner.title: Error reporting
design-partner.description: Sends structure-only counts when the app gets stuck.
design-partner.not-sent: Never your content, file names, client names, or prompts.
design-partner.field-features: Which features you used: ask, workflow, search, email import. A count only, not what you asked.
design-partner.field-workflow-id: Which workflow template you ran (the template id, not the output).
design-partner.field-search-count: How many searches you ran. No query text.
design-partner.field-install-id: Your anonymous install id plus app version and platform.
design-partner.endpoint-note: Endpoint: forms.lanternplatform.app/api/forms/lantern/design-partner-event. Used only to improve the product for your firm.

telemetry.title: Usage stats
telemetry.description: Sends basic app events like launch, trial start, and license activation. No content, files, AI prompts, or email.
telemetry.field-install-id: <c>install_id</c>: a random UUID generated on this machine (visible below). Not tied to your email or license.
telemetry.field-app-version: <c>app_version</c>, <c>platform</c>: which build of {{productName}}, and macOS / Windows / Linux.
telemetry.endpoint-note: Endpoint: <c>forms.lanternplatform.app/api/forms/lantern/app-event</c>. JSONL stored on {{productNamePossessive}} server. Used only for funnel metrics and roadmap decisions.

email.title: Email updates
email.intro: If you opted into email updates at first launch (or via the website), you'll get launch announcements and discount codes. No drip campaigns, no weekly newsletters.
email.unsub: To remove yourself from the list, reply <c>UNSUB</c> to any {{productName}} email. All replies go straight to support.
email.empty: You haven't signed up for product emails.

data-map.title: Where your data lives and who can see it
data-map.description: A plain-English map of what stays on your machine, what is sent to your AI provider, and what {{productNamePossessive}} own servers see (only a license check). You can print it or save it as a PDF to show a client.

email-reply-ai.title: AI email reply classification
email-reply-ai.description: Off by default. When enabled, {{productName}} sends the text of authenticated client email replies to your firm's configured AI provider to help match an onboarding item. Turn this on only when your firm approves that sharing.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.description: Expose your {{productName}} workspace to any MCP-compatible AI client. Install once, then ask Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any other client about your notes, chats, and memory facts without copy-pasting.

status.ready: Ready to install in Claude Desktop
status.unavailable: MCP server is not available in this build. Install the desktop app to use MCP.

mcp.disabled-title: MCP is off: network lockdown is on
mcp.disabled-body: While a client with network lockdown is active (or On this computer only is selected), MCP servers are disabled so confidential work cannot leave your machine through an outside AI client. Any write an MCP client attempts is blocked and recorded in your audit log. Turn off network lockdown to use MCP again.

install.heading: How to install:
install.step-download: Click Download .mcpb above to copy the bundle path to your clipboard.
install.step-config: Open Settings, Developer, Edit Config, or drag the .mcpb file into the Claude Desktop window.
install.step-pick-folder: When prompted for a workspace folder, pick the same folder you opened in {{productName}}.
install.after-install: After install, ask Claude "search my {{productName}} workspace for X" or "read notes/plan.md" and watch it work.

mcp-approval.title: Claude Desktop wants to write to your workspace
mcp-approval.description: Review the change below. Nothing happens until you approve.
mcp-approval.more-queued_one: 1 more write queued after this one.
mcp-approval.more-queued_other: {{count}} more writes queued after this one.
mcp-approval.privileged-blocked: Network lockdown is on. MCP servers are disabled, so this write was blocked and nothing was changed on your machine.
mcp-approval.privileged-auto-denied: Blocked and recorded in your audit log. Turn off network lockdown to allow external AI writes again.

ollama.title: Ollama (local models)
ollama.description: Run AI models directly on your machine: free, offline, private. {{productName}} talks to a locally running Ollama daemon on <c>127.0.0.1:11434</c>.

status.not-running: Ollama not running. Install it to run AI models locally, free.

ollama.no-models-hint: Ollama is running but no models are installed. Pull one with <c>ollama pull llama3.2:3b</c> and click Check again.

why.heading: Why Ollama?
why.zero-cost: Zero cost. Inference runs on your GPU / CPU.
why.zero-network: Zero network. Works on a plane, offline, in a tunnel.
why.zero-data: Zero data sharing. Your prompts never leave the machine.

ollama.recommended-model: Recommended first model: <c>llama3.2:3b</c> (about 2 GB, runs on almost any laptop).

memory-facts.title: Memory Facts
memory-facts.description: Durable facts about you that the AI always knows. Stored locally at <c>.lantern/memory.json</c> in your workspace.

template-models.title: Per-template model assignment
template-models.description: Pin a provider and model for each template. Leave blank to use the template's built-in default (or your global default).

mobile-page.title: Phone access
mobile-page.description: Read this workspace on your phone with iCloud, Dropbox, Syncthing, or Google Drive.
mobile-page.heads-up-text: For now, read on phone. Edit on one device at a time.

icloud.label: iCloud Drive
icloud.guidance: Best if you use Apple devices.

dropbox.label: Dropbox
dropbox.guidance: Works across Mac, Windows, iPhone, and Android.

syncthing.label: Syncthing
syncthing.guidance: Keeps data between your own devices without a cloud account.

gdrive.label: Google Drive
gdrive.guidance: Best if you already use Google Drive, especially on Android.

api-keys.title: AI Account Keys
api-keys.description: Configure account keys for AI model providers. Keys are stored securely and never logged.
api-keys.credential-service-unavailable: Windows' credential storage service isn't running, so {{productName}} can't reach your saved AI keys right now. This does not affect your documents. Restart the "Credential Manager" service (services.msc), or try again shortly.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Manage installed plugins and the settings each plugin contributes.
plugins.empty: No plugins installed yet. Install one from a plugin tarball to see it here.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Hands-free capture via a bundled offline speech-recognition model. Audio never leaves your machine. Press-to-talk inserts into the focused text field; voice-to-note saves a new text file into <c>Inbox/</c>.
voice.status-denied: Mic permission denied. Allow microphone access to use voice.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Power-user settings, including per-feature kill switches. Streams populate as features land.

language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the language used throughout the app.

settings-page.no-settings: This plugin did not declare any settings.

sidebar.no-html: This plugin panel did not render any HTML.

local-ai-settings.title: {{localAiName}}
local-ai-settings.description: A private AI that runs entirely on this computer. Your files and questions never leave the machine. It's slightly less sharp than the cloud models, but nothing you ask ever goes online. One-time download, about 2.4 GB.
local-ai-settings.error: The download was interrupted. Nothing is lost.
